events.name: Courtside Cardshow Miami
events.info: Courtside Cardshow Miami October 2-4, 2026 Miami, Florida Sports Cards Pokemon TCG The BIGGEST CARD SHOW IN FLORIDA returns bigger than ever. Courtside Cardshow Miami is expanding from a 2-day show to a 3-day experience, bringing together 350+ tables and Americas top dealers in one premier, oceanfront venue. This is where serious collectors, investors, and enthusiasts come to buy, sell, and trade at the highest level. Featuring appearances and participation from industry leaders like PSA, Goldin, Heritage and OnlyAlt, plus elite vendors from across the country, this is not your typical local show it is a national level marketplace. Whether you are chasing grails, building inventory, or networking with the biggest names in the hobby, Courtside Cardshow Miami delivers the ultimate collectibles experience in the 305. For any questions, DM and follow us on Instagram @CourtsideCardshow
events.pleaseNote: All bags are subject to inspection by our security team upon entry.

events.name: DeathMatch - Competitive Improv Show
events.info: DeathMatch - Short-Form Improv Comedy in Miami Two teams enter - one team wins! Two teams of improvisors complete in an all out comedy brawl performing fast-paced improv games completing for your laughs. Who wins? You decide! This show features members of our award-winning JTF cast and invited alums and improv celebrity performers. Tickets are PER PERSON for this show. We will seat parties together in tables. We will do our best to sit larger groups as close as possible, but may have to split large groups if they arrive late. Tickets are NON REFUNDABLE after purchase. The show STARTS at 9pm and ENDS at around 10:50pm.
